rule.statement: A dedication of immovable property to the Sangha or a Buddhist temple does not become invalid by the absence of a notarial document.
rule.supporting_quote: Applying the principles laid down in the above judicial decisions, I hold that when a person dedicates an immovable property to the Sangha or to a Buddhist Temple on behalf of Sanga, such a dedication does not become invalid by the absence of a notarial document.
